$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-10{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} &=15{x}_{3} \\ -7{x}_{3} &=13\end{aligned}\right.
$$

$$

$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}-10 & -2 & -15 \\ 0 & 0 & -7\end{bmatrix}
$$

\left\{\begin{aligned}7a+13b+0c &=-7 \\ 1a-1b-3c &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}7 & 13 & 0 \\ 1 & -1 & -3\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}7 & 13 & 0 & -7 \\ 1 & -1 & -3 & 0\end{array}\right]
$$
